name: FFS, Second Lead Syndrome?!
source:
Right after you finish reading the ‘Beastly Duke of the North,’ you find yourself transported into the novel’s world, not as the Main Character or even the Villainess, but as a barely mentioned runaway bride-to-be number three. 

All in all, it’s a dream come true (lounging around all day and a hefty monthly allowance, here you come!), only that the Novel’s God seems determined to send you back to your old life?!

Not a chance! Screw the MC, you were here first!

[From [url=https://chthonicchromestudio.itch.io/ffs-second-lead-syndrome]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你读完《北方野兽公爵》后，你会发现自己进入了小说的世界，不是主角，甚至不是恶女，而是一个几乎没有被提及的离家出走的第三号新娘。

总而言之，真是美梦成真（整天闲逛，每月高额零用钱，你来了！），只是小说之神似乎铁了心要把你送回以前的生活？！

没有机会！去他妈的MC，你先来的！

[来自[url=https://chthonicchromestudio.itch.io/ffs-second-lead-syndrome]itch.io[/url]]
